audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[0..6].side gave Irelia all seven stages while content win[4..6] and the packet levelChart give Azir the last three. Ratings stayed 6-7/10 on rows Azir is meant to win.
audit.why: Azir is 52.04% over 442 games — the page cannot give the enemy every stage of a lane its owner wins. Emperor's Divide is terrain, and terrain is what stops a 600-range dash.
audit.corrected: Irelia x4 then Azir x3 on both layers, ratings lowered on the flipped rows, whys rewritten to argue Azir's side from the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] read "Irelia hits 3 items on Q resets" at levels 3-5, which is not a coherent spike, and wants.foe[2] referred to a "level 6 true damage threshold".
audit.why: Her levels 3-5 spike is Bladesurge resetting off Marked targets and kills for 15 mana. Her level 6 is Vanguard's Edge (125/105/85, 950), which Marks and leaves a slowing wall.
audit.corrected: Spike restated on the reset mechanic; the level 6 line restated on Vanguard's Edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: The lane's decisive interaction was missing: Flawless Duet GROUNDS, which turns off Azir's Shifting Sands. The page only called it "her stun setup". breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: Flawless Duet (16/14.5/13/11.5/10, 850) stuns, Marks and grounds; Azir's E is flagged as a dash that grounding denies. Worse, the Mark it applies refreshes Bladesurge — so the same ability that takes your escape away also gives her a free reset.
audit.corrected: Grounding and the Mark-to-reset chain stated in tldr, enemyWin, loading, cooldowns and dosFull[0..1]; real cooldowns added.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early both credited Ionian Fervor with "stacking true damage".
audit.why: Riot's text: Ionian Fervor gives stacking bonus Attack Speed, and bonus damage on hit only at maximum stacks — it never says true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was not tied to Bladesurge anywhere in the lane text.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal — Bladesurge heals her on every dash, including off minions.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal folded into breakdown.feeding and breakdown.carry.

notes: Two factual errors corrected: Ionian Fervor grants stacking ATTACK SPEED (bonus on-hit damage only at max stacks), not true damage — the page claimed true damage in whys[0], early and wants.foe[2]. And Flawless Duet's GROUNDING was absent everywhere; it is the reason Azir cannot Shifting Sands out of her all-in, and the Mark it applies is what refreshes Bladesurge. spikes[0] read "hits 3 items on Q resets" at levels 3-5, which is not a coherent claim. "Shurima's Legacy" in spikes[1] and mid is Azir's real passive name and was left alone. Report sweep cap respected: only report[0].t and report[1].t rewritten; report[3].t, report[4].t, report[5].t, report[8].t and report[11].t still misgender Irelia and mirror text this proposal corrects upstream.
